scope: Every VISUAL_TEMPLATES entry in the inspected local SlideGenAI source. Metadata is descriptive, not executable template code or an official third-party brand guide.

analytical.keep: Alignment, clear evidence hierarchy and consistent scales.

editorial.keep: Type scale, purposeful crop and deliberate whitespace.

technical.keep: Precise line work, labeled relationships and strong grouping.

organic.keep: Human scale, softer cadence and image-led variation.
